_readme: Which specialist should answer each question, and in which shape (skill).
Labels are what a correct router should answer, never what the rules happen to return today:
a label written to match the implementation measures nothing. Where the offline rules disagree,
app/evaluation/specialist_routing.py records it in KNOWN_MISROUTES with the exact wrong answer,
so an improvement fails the test as loudly as a regression.
`skill` is the specialist's own skill name (pick_skill), or a pipeline skill for general / pdf_text.
`boundary` marks a question written to sit on the edge between two classes; `why` says which edge.
Every class has at least one question in each language.

queries.why: an attack on an AI application is a security question, not a model question

queries.question: How do I defend our chatbot against prompt injection?
queries.why: same edge as edge-01, in English

queries.question: Spring 的依赖注入是怎么实现的？
queries.why: 注入 in a software-design sense; must not be read as an attack

queries.question: 这份 pdf 里的表格合计是多少？
queries.why: Q3 (2026-09-27): a question needing a calculation over a table goes to data_analysis, which has table tools; pdf_text can only quote

queries.question: 用 AI 检测网络入侵有哪些方法？
queries.why: the goal is detecting intrusion; AI is the means

queries.question: What GPU memory does a 7B model need for LoRA fine-tuning?
queries.why: a model-engineering estimate with no security wording

queries.question: Please send an email to the team about the outage.
queries.why: "ai" must not match inside "email" (a recorded historical misroute)

queries.question: 把这份漏洞扫描报告 PDF 里的高危漏洞列出来

queries.question: 大模型的训练数据被投毒了怎么办？
